summary: The Network Information Center asks participants to make enough copies of any manuals or handbooks they produce so the NIC can distribute them. The NIC planned to send them to Station Agents, to Liaisons, and when useful to outside participants.

plainLanguage.summary: The Network Information Center asks network participants to send copies of important manuals and handbooks. It plans to distribute them to people who need reference materials.

subtitle: The Network Information Center requests manuals for network-wide distribution.

tldr.problem: Network participants needed reference manuals and handbooks from sites around the network.
tldr.mechanism: The NIC asks document-producing sites to provide copies for distribution to Station Agents, Liaisons and, when useful, outside participants.
tldr.outcome: The NIC planned to make 100 copies of most documents to cover the then-growing group and replacements.

today: RFC 185 is a document distribution notice published in July 1971. The unit metadata lists its status as Unknown.

sections.title: The NIC's Distribution Plan
sections.content: The Network Information Center asked network participants to provide enough copies of basic manuals and handbooks for the NIC to distribute. The planned recipients included Station Agents, Liaisons and, when appropriate, people outside the network who needed to understand it.
sections.plainLanguage: The NIC wanted to distribute useful manuals to people across the network. It asked the groups that wrote them to provide copies.

sections.title: Number of Copies
sections.content: The number of network participants receiving documents was approaching 80. The NIC said it usually made 100 copies of most documents to cover additions and replacements, and asked members issuing manuals or other large working documents to provide 100 copies when they were issued.
sections.plainLanguage: The NIC asked sites to provide 100 copies of most important documents. This allowed for the current distribution and for replacement copies.

sections.title: Who Receives the Documents
sections.content: The NIC planned to distribute reference copies to Station Agents and Liaisons, and to outside participants when it considered that useful for understanding the network.
sections.plainLanguage: Station Agents and Liaisons would receive reference copies. The NIC could also send copies to outside participants when needed.
